description: Create PDF invoices, estimates, receipts, contracts, non-disclosure agreements, and real estate documents. Preview each document and add a payment link or QR code. Built by Moosh Works (https://mooshworks.com).

defaultPrompt: Create a consulting invoice with a payment link and QR code.
Convert project estimate EST-2026-0042 into an invoice.
Draft a commercial lease summary with base rent and common area maintenance charges.
interface.longDescription: Create PDF invoices, estimates, receipts, contracts, non-disclosure agreements, and real estate documents. Preview each document and add a payment link or QR code. Built by Moosh Works (https://mooshworks.com).

publication.release_notes: Version 1.2.4 clarifies document setup and customer-sync disclosures. Release notes: https://github.com/mooshee/pressmark/releases/tag/v1.2.4

review.commerce_description: Pressmark creates and previews documents. Payment links open a checkout page; Pressmark does not collect payments in chat.

negative.description: Geography and weather questions are outside Pressmark's scope
negative.prompt: What is the capital of France and what will the weather be like there tomorrow?

negative.description: Travel reservations are outside Pressmark's scope
negative.prompt: Book a direct roundtrip flight from New York to London departing next Friday.

negative.description: Bank transfers are outside Pressmark's scope
negative.prompt: Transfer $500 from my checking account to my savings account right now.

positive.description: Freelance consulting invoice with Stripe checkout link and mobile QR code
positive.expected_behavior: A PDF invoice totaling $3,750.00, a PNG preview displayed in chat, and a QR code for the supplied payment link.
positive.prompt: Generate a freelance consulting invoice from Sample Studio (sender@example.com) to Sample Client (recipient@example.com) for 15 hours of Systems Architecture at $250/hr, due in 14 days, with payment link https://example.com/pay/invoice and a mobile QR code.

positive.description: Convert an estimate to an invoice
positive.expected_behavior: Document re-sequenced to INV-2026-0042, issue date updated to today, due date set to +30 days, status marked pending with payment link.
positive.prompt: Convert my project estimate EST-2026-0042 ($5,000 for Mobile App Design) into an official Tax Invoice due in 30 days with payment link https://example.com/pay/project.

positive.description: Commercial lease summary with base rent and common area maintenance charges
positive.expected_behavior: A multi-page commercial lease document with monthly base rent of $11,083.33 and common area maintenance charges of $2,479.17, totaling $13,562.50 per month, plus operating expense terms and signature lines.
positive.prompt: Draft a commercial triple-net (NNN) lease summary for Suite 400 at 100 Innovation Way between Hallman Properties LLC (Landlord) and TechVentures Inc (Tenant), 3,500 sq ft at $38/sqft/yr base rent, plus $8.50/sqft/yr estimated CAM charges, starting November 1, 2026.

positive.description: Record a payment and create a receipt
positive.expected_behavior: A receipt marked 'PAID IN FULL', a $0.00 balance due, and the supplied transaction reference.
positive.prompt: Record full payment of $3,750 for invoice INV-2026-001 received via Stripe Card on October 7, 2026 (transaction ID: sample-payment-001) and generate an official paid receipt.

positive.expected_behavior: Calculates subtotal $3,600.00, tax $333.00, discount $150.00, grand total $3,783.00, and returns the Solo Pro subscription and single-pass pricing.
positive.prompt: Calculate line-item totals with 9.25% sales tax and a $150 early-payment discount for 3 laptops at $1,200 each, and tell me the subscription cost to remove watermarks on future exports.
